title: Top 500 Characters
description: Most common 500 characters. For serious readers.
source: Character sequence from Jun Da's Modern Chinese Character Frequency List (lingua.mtsu.edu/chinese-computing), via the ruddfawcett/hanziDB.csv dataset on GitHub. Used for educational purposes. Individual characters are standard Chinese.
notes: This pack is the long-form expansion of the Top 100 Frequent pack — same source, same sequencing principle, just five times bigger. The first 100 entries are identical to the Top 100 pack, so kids who already practiced that pack will see those words merge without losing progress. Frequency-ordered means grammar particles and function words come first, with concrete nouns and verbs distributed throughout. For a kid working ~5 new characters per week, this pack is a roughly 2-year curriculum. Pairs well with thematic packs (YCT, Sagebooks) for variety.
